**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 22 already delivers our preferred audit position in full:

- **Frequency:** no more than once in any twelve-month period (22.1)
- **Notice:** at least thirty days' prior written notice (22.1)
- **Manner:** normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption, off-site where practicable, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1)
- **Cost:** Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent for the audited period (22.2)
- **System access:** express prohibition on Vendor/auditor accessing our systems directly, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, or another supplier's confidential information (22.2)

Section 22.3 adds further protections in our favour (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of the final report, and finality on payment of a shortfall absent fraud or demonstrable error).

Section 23 ("Records and Customer Assurance") is a heading with no operative text, so it does not extend any audit right, and a document-wide search surfaced no other audit, inspection, or verification rights binding us.
